edits.before: The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Parallel Convergence arms on a delay from 1600 range — place it where he must swap back, then string the trade inside it.

edits.before: Q through him, E the gap, passive third hit, walk out through the slow — the full string chunks and the return pass pays the exit.

edits.before: Blinking in with R down against a loaded kit — Ekko without the rewind is a mid laner doing parkour at a funeral.
edits.after: His Q damages every target in the line, so standing in his wave turns Razor Shuriken into free damage on you.

edits.before: Zed wins by landing Death Mark, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Zed wins by poking through Living Shadow at 900 range, then marking you at 6 and bursting before Chronobreak is up.

edits.before: Carry through insured dives — one carry per rewind cycle; your job is spending R as a weapon, not an apology.
edits.after: Carry by timing the rewind — Chronobreak takes you untargetable exactly when his mark is due to detonate.
